name: Foundry VTT
tagline: Virtual tabletop for your RPG nights
description: Virtual tabletop: host D&D, Pathfinder and every other system for your party, with dynamic lighting, tokens and hundreds of system modules.
compose:
services:
  foundry:
    image: felddy/foundryvtt:release
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:30000"
    environment:
      FOUNDRY_LICENSE_KEY: "${{cfg.license_key}}"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
